dateline: BTS opened a sold-out three-night Lima run at Estadio San Marcos on Oct 7 with 'Hooligan'; Santiago (Oct 14, 16, 17) is next.
heroHeadline: Day 4,869: BTS Wraps Lima, Santiago Next
heroSubtitle: October 12, 2026 is Day 4,869 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three Lima shows at Estadio San Marcos (Oct 7, 9, 10), the ARIRANG World Tour heads to Santiago (Oct 14, 16, 17), then Buenos Aires and São Paulo.
